levels.description: Reduces the chance of stumbling or being knocked off balance by a hit stick.
Reduces fatigue buildup and speeds up stamina recovery.
Reduces the wear-and-tear penalty from heavy usage over a game.
Improves ball-fake quality on play-action and pump fakes.
Improves throw accuracy when standing in a clean pocket with no pressure.
Improves agility for maneuvering around the pocket to avoid pressure.
Greatly improves accuracy on off-platform throws (across the body or on the back foot) to receivers up to 40 yards downfield.
Improves the chance to break free from a sack attempt.
Improves resistance to pressure while throwing on the run.
Improves resistance to pressure while standing in the pocket.
Improves accuracy when throwing to an open receiver with feet set in a clean pocket.
Improves ball security when sacked or when throwing.
Improves speed and throw accuracy on option pitches.
Improves accuracy on throws made while on the run outside the pocket.
Improves accuracy when throwing before the receiver breaks on their route.
Improves the chance to break tackles.
Improves the effectiveness of the stiff arm move.
Reduces the speed lost when cutting.
Improves the effectiveness of the juke move.
Improves the effectiveness of the spin move.
Improves the chance to break tackles once the ball carrier reaches max speed.
Increases fatigue dealt to a defender who is run through on a tackle attempt.
Improves ball security, reducing fumble chance.
Improves catch chance on contested jump balls thrown more than 10 yards downfield or in the end zone.
Improves route running against man coverage and catching when lined up in the backfield.
Improves the chance to secure diving catches.
Reduces drops and prevents the ball from being knocked out on contact.
Improves cut quality on routes run against man coverage.
Improves the chance to win double-move routes against single man coverage.
Improves the ability to beat press coverage at the line of scrimmage.
Improves release speed off the line when not being pressed.
Improves pass blocking inside 10 yards of the first-down marker.
Improves pass-block movement on standard dropback pass plays.
Improves option blocking near the line of scrimmage.
Improves run blocking on inside runs near the line of scrimmage.
Improves blocking on screen plays, including the chance to pancake a defender.
Improves play-action pass blocking on 1st down or when there are fewer than 3 yards to go.
Improves blocking once the lineman reaches the second level of the defense.
Improves first-level run blocking on outside runs.
Reduces the chance of being shed laterally on run or pass plays.
Adds fatigue to a defender who gets pancaked on a run play.
Adds fatigue to a defender who gets pancaked on a pass play.
Improves movement when pulling as a blocker.
Improves the effectiveness of the hit stick tackle.
Prevents broken tackles during a sack attempt.
Improves the chance to force a fumble on a tackle and prevents broken tackles when breaking up a catch.
Generates pressure on the quarterback when unblocked and rushing from in front.
Prevents broken tackles and fake-outs (jukes and spins) while tackling.
Improves the chance to beat an impact (lead) block.
Improves block shedding against inside runs, including double teams.
Improves block shedding against outside runs, including double teams.
Improves block shedding against option runs, including double teams.
Improves pass-rush block shedding, especially on 3rd and 4th down.
Improves the ability to shed blocks laterally on any play.
Greatly increases wear-and-tear fatigue dealt to opponents on tackles.
Improves timing when jumping the snap count.
Fatigues receivers and slows their acceleration on zone chucks at the line of scrimmage.
Improves the ability to press receivers at the line of scrimmage.
Improves interception chance and stamina during interception returns.
Improves reaction to route cuts in man coverage.
Improves closing speed and movement in man or zone coverage.
Improves the break on the ball after a pass is thrown.
Improves accuracy and timing on field goals of 50+ yards.
Removes the penalty for kicking the ball out of the back of the end zone.
Improves punt accuracy when punting from midfield or closer.
Improves punt timing when punting from the kicking team's own 10-yard line or further back.
Improves accuracy and timing on short field goals.
Increases composure gained while playing on the road.
Increases composure gained in the final 2 minutes of a game decided by 10 points or less.
Increases composure gained while playing at home.
Resists failed pre-play adjustments and protects composure from crowd noise.
Reveals pre-snap blitzes, coverage shells, and disguised coverages.
Improves accuracy and timing, and removes icing effects, on field goals in the final 2 minutes.
Removes the effects of bad weather on play.
Removes the rating penalty for playing out of position.
Increases the QB's composure when this receiver makes a 1st-down catch on 3rd or 4th down.
Increases a defensive lineman's composure after recording a sack.
Increases an offensive lineman's composure after a pancake block.
Increases a defensive back's composure after an interception or pass breakup.
Improves reaction time to run plays on defense.
Speeds up recovery from wear-and-tear fatigue while on the sideline.
Increases the swings, positive and negative, in composure gain and loss.
